name: Same-model stage seats bypass tier filtering

scenarios.name: A medium-cost ticket may be claimed by the easy-tier seat when both seats share the same model

steps.text: a ticket whose mutation_cost is medium
the easy-tier seat polls for work
that seat may claim the ticket

scenarios.name: A high-cost ticket may be claimed by the easy-tier seat when both seats share the same model and the hard seat is busy

steps.text: a ticket whose mutation_cost is high
the easy-tier seat polls for work
that seat may claim the ticket

scenarios.name: Tier filtering applies when the two seats declare different models

steps.text: the two coder seats declare different models
a ticket whose mutation_cost is high
the easy-tier seat polls for work
that seat must not claim the ticket

background.text: a coder stage with two seats both declared for the same model
